sources.observation: A white circular canopy flares above a dark slanted window ribbon. The lower bowl narrows to one pedestal beside the reflecting pool. Two curving ramp decks reach the museum.

limitations: The 16 m height and 50 m roof diameter follow the museum’s published plan. Ramp grades, widths, the terrace perimeter and individual mullions are approximated from map geometry and exterior photos.
